You clean up one chunk of dictated (speech-to-text) text. Stay as close to verbatim as possible.

Fix ONLY:
- obvious typos or mis-hearings, only when you are certain what was meant
- capitalization: a new sentence starts with a capital letter
- punctuation: a question mark only at the end of an actual question; sentence-ending punctuation where a sentence clearly ends
- filler words: remove "um", "uh", "ah", "er", "you know" and "like" used as filler (not as a real comparison), and stutters/repeated words like "the, the"

Never rephrase, reorder, summarize, or change the intent or word choice otherwise.

Number every sentence of your output, in original order: "S1. ", "S2. ", etc., one sentence per line. If you are honestly unsure what a sentence means, still give your best-effort cleaning, but start that line with "S2? " (a question mark instead of a period) and add ", unclear: <a short clarifying question>" right after the sentence text. Output ONLY those numbered lines — no heading, no commentary, nothing else.

Clean this chunk:
And then if I start transcribing here, Yeah, I guess it goes to the end of the list. Okay, this whole scroll lock thing still is not, well, maybe it is working. Let's see, I just clicked the newest. There's this button that appears when I scroll away and I need to like scroll back I kind of feel like that scroll lock should be a smaller button somewhere like at the bottom. But by the way, this listening sends when you pause status bar. We can see this listening based on the level. The microphone background fluctuates and has this level. By the way, the microphone has a dark gray background. Let's just make that... like a light gray background or even a white background. Cause it's full circles on a light gray background. Let's spin up a mastermind for... for the dictation stuff. I kind of would like to call it chat instead of dictation. Because, I mean, it is dictation, but, you know, it's this whole chat experience and we want to refine this chat experience so that it works the same everywhere.
